kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Major investments in Aurora, Joliet, M Resort and Columbus development projects
kpis.description: Total investments committed for key development projects: Aurora ($225M), Joliet ($130M received in August 2025), M Resort ($150M received in November 2025), Columbus ($70M commitment expired). Financing structured via GLPI REIT through master leases.
kpis.signal: Major strategic property transformation development program

kpis.name: Hollywood Casino Council Bluffs Project
kpis.explanation: Project to relocate Ameristar Council Bluffs property to new land-based casino
kpis.description: Relocation announced April 24, 2025 of Ameristar Council Bluffs riverboat casino to 125,000 square foot land-based facility with over 1,000 gaming positions. Opening targeted for late 2027 to early 2028. GLPI has committed up to $150M financing at 7.1% cap rate.
kpis.signal: Major transformation project with GLPI committed financing of up to $150M

risks.title: Goodwill impairment deterioration
risks.score_rationale: Interactive segment goodwill was fully impaired with an impairment loss of $825 million, exceeding the accounting balance. Language emphasizes sensitivity of assumptions (revenues, discount rates) and risk of future impairment charges if forecasts are not achieved. 'Capital' category heavily weighted here.

risks.title: Gaming license sensitivity
risks.score_rationale: Several licenses (e.g., L'Auberge Lake Charles) have pass-through margins below 1%, with significant impairment risk if discount rate increases 100 bps. Text underscores dependence on local regulations and future cash flow assumptions.

risks.title: Variable interest rate risk
risks.score_rationale: $1.99 billion of variable rate debt exposed to SOFR fluctuations. Maturity schedule shows high concentration in 2027. Rising rates directly impact debt costs.

risks.title: Local economic shocks
risks.score_rationale: Projected cash flows are sensitive to unemployment, inflation and interest rates. Repeated mention in goodwill and license sections. Critical assumptions for DCF models.

risks.title: Unhedged currency risk
risks.score_rationale: No hedging of currency exposure, notably on Canadian dollar. Significant unrealized currency gains/losses (e.g., $139M loss in 2024). Direct impact on consolidated financial statements.

risks.title: Gaming tax increases
risks.score_rationale: Cited as direct negative factor on cash flows in Interactive and physical segments. Recurring regulatory risk, with discretionary authority of states and provinces.

ai_positioning.summary: Penn company does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. Information provided focuses on financial aspects, business segments and company operations, without reference to AI or related technology.
